context: Found while verifying PR #3184. Not caused by it. Update 2026-10-20: develop adopted benchbox-sqlglot 30.24.0.1 in #3189 (15:30 EDT), and ci.yml runs on develop-based PRs are passing again (19:38Z success), so the immediate block is cleared without a waiver. description: From 2026-10-20 about 17:20Z, ci-paths 'Check release content' fails on every PR with: 'sqlglot upstream freshness FAILED: bundled SQLGlot is based on upstream v30.23.0 but v30.24.0 is released; refresh the fork (see downstream/MAINTAINING.md in https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/benchbox-sqlglot) and adopt the new wheel, or record a reviewed waiver for v30.24.0 in scripts/sqlglot_refresh_waiver.json'. Seen on PR #3184 (run 39465643741): ci-paths failed, so core, docs, explorer, results-data and tooling all fail. Runs at 16:44Z and 17:03Z passed, so the gate began failing when upstream released. scripts/sqlglot_refresh_waiver.json currently has no waivers. The gate came in with #3148 and runs inside release-check on every PR, so any upstream SQLGlot release blocks all merging until a human refreshes the fork or waives it. No PR or issue addressing it was found when checked.
